title: Out-of-turn Codex compaction notice can land above the previous turn's first assistant message
outcome:
Moving the contextCompaction branch ahead of the active-turn filter (src/codex_events.rs:832) also removed the placement guard on its transcript notice. The block now runs before shared_codex_app_server_event_matches_active_turn, so any item/completed carrying a contextCompaction item reaches push_shared_codex_turn_notice regardless of turn. That helper inserts before turn_state.first_visible_assistant_message_id whenever the anchor is set, and the anchor is cleared only after the completed-turn grace period (5s in non-test builds). A manual or idle compaction arriving inside that window therefore renders the boundary notice ABOVE output that preceded it, while the same event arriving later appends at the end. Same event, two different placements, decided by timing.

Not established: how often a Codex build emits a compaction item inside that window. What is established is that the code makes the inconsistency reachable.

Direction: for the out-of-turn case bypass the anchor and append - pass the anchor only when the event turn id matches the active turn - so a boundary outside the work turn is never drawn above older output.

Found by the cache review pair over frozen tree HEAD 272965d; confirmed by reading source, no runtime reproduction.
